title: How do i use scrim servers?

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: I believe you need to be a team leader in order to reserve a scrim server; not sure though. But to reserve one, go under competitive, and click scrimmage. Then choose a time that you want, reserve it, and it'll tell you instructions on how to join the server.
